import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import os
import json

from tqdm import tqdm

# List of links to loop through
links = [
    'https://devoxx.ma/talks-by-sessions/?id=18901',
    'https://devoxx.ma/talks-by-sessions/?id=18902',
    'https://devoxx.ma/talks-by-sessions/?id=18903',
    'https://devoxx.ma/talks-by-sessions/?id=20151',
    'https://devoxx.ma/talks-by-sessions/?id=968',
    'https://devoxx.ma/talks-by-sessions/?id=955',
    'https://devoxx.ma/talks-by-sessions/?id=959',
    'https://devoxx.ma/talks-by-sessions/?id=978',
    'https://devoxx.ma/talks-by-sessions/?id=951',
    'https://devoxx.ma/talks-by-sessions/?id=960',
    'https://devoxx.ma/talks-by-sessions/?id=954'
]

talks_data = []
errors = []

for link in links:
    response = requests.get(link)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, 'html.parser')

    articles = soup.select('div.cfp-group article.cfp-article.cfp-row.cfp-event')

    if len(articles) == 0:
        print(f"No talks found for link: {link}")
        continue

    for article in tqdm(articles, desc="Processing articles", total=len(articles)):
        talk_data = {}

        # Get talk link
        talk_link = 'https://devoxx.ma' + article.select_one('.cfp-field:last-of-type a')['href']
        talk_data['link'] = talk_link

        # Make request to talk page
        talk_response = requests.get(talk_link)
        talk_soup = BeautifulSoup(talk_response.content, 'html.parser')

        # Get talk name
        talk_data['talkName'] = soup.sele
